Old resume? Paste it or upload PDF — we renovate it into a new one

↻ Renovate your old resume

Already have a resume? Upload it as a PDF — or paste its full text below. The details fill themselves automatically — as soon as you paste or the PDF loads, CareerGlow reads it and fills your name, contact, job title, jobs, education, skills and the other sections it finds straight into the form below (filled fields flash gold, so you can check them). Anything the old resume doesn't mention stays exactly as you left it. You can still edit every filled field, or tap Renovate to apply it again.

PDF tip: text-based PDFs work best. If your PDF is a scanned image with no selectable text, open it, copy any readable text, and paste it above instead.

Auto-fill is on by default: paste text, drop a file, or load a PDF and the matching fields below fill themselves — no extra tap needed. Turn it off if you prefer to fill only when you tap Renovate.

Details filled from your old resume

    These details are now filled in the steps below and live in the preview — check or edit any field, change the template or colour theme, and the new look updates instantly. Add anything extra with add-ons and a job description, and it all applies on top.

    1 Your details

    The form starts blank — nothing is pre-filled. Type your details, upload your old resume above and they fill in automatically, or tap “Load sample resume” to see a filled example first. Everything updates the preview live as you type.

    ▾

    2 Professional summary

    Write your own, or let the built-in writer draft one from your role, experience and skills — it runs right here in the page, no AI API, no expiry. The role box searches a big built-in list covering every kind of job — kitchen, driving, trades, care work, shops, offices and more: start typing and matching roles appear, even with small typos — tap one to select it. If your exact role is not listed, type it and tap the gold “Use …” option to keep your own role. Experience is yours to type, any number.

    ▾

    3 Work experience

    One entry per job. Write one achievement per line — start each line with a strong verb and add numbers where you can (%, ₹, team size, time saved).

    4 Education

    Your highest qualification first.

    5 Skills

    Add the skills the job asks for. Tap a suggestion to add it, or type your own.

    6 Match a job description

    Paste the job description you're applying to. CareerGlow scans it for the skills recruiters search for and shows what to add — your resume tunes itself to the job.

    Already in your resume

    Missing — tap to add

    7 Add-ons

    Switch on the extra sections you want — they appear in the form and in the resume instantly.

      Get your resume

      For a PDF: download the resume file, open it in any browser, then Print → Save as PDF (A4, margins “None”). The downloaded file stays editable — reopen it anytime and print again.

      CareerGlow runs entirely in this page — your details never leave your device, there is no account, no API key and nothing that can expire. Build as many resumes as you like, for as many roles as you like.
